name: @amykit/plugin-concurrent-engine
description: Advances one work item per tick, moving every lane of a fork at once.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it in place of serial-engine when a workflow forks into lanes that should move together, such as ticket-to-qa running its gate and its self-review side by side. Everything else is the serial engine's, settings included: the same claim on a queue item and the same budget check before each lane's call. An install mounts one engine, so pick this one or serial-engine, with file-queue and file-store beside it.
